name: Voronica Cleans House: a Vore Adventure
source:
Voronica didn't think twice when she was offered a job as a 'removalist', but she's never thought twice in her life! This hungry, horny bunny now has to clear a whole house of its infestation of "tinies" and there's only one way to make sure they stay gone... Down the hatch!

Nothing is ever simple though. Voronica will have to deal with a capricious boss, an overbearing tenant, his hyper-submissive wife and a surprise visit from an old friend. Complicating matters even further, Voronica's new "diet" has unexpected impacts on her body, and she begins to grow and change…

translation:
沃罗妮卡接到一份“清除员”的工作时，想都没想就答应了。不过，她这辈子本来也没怎么多想过！这只饥肠辘辘、欲火难耐的兔女郎，如今必须清除整栋房子里泛滥成灾的“小人”。要确保他们彻底消失，只有一个办法……一口吞下去！

然而，事情从来不会那么简单。沃罗妮卡得应付一个反复无常的老板、一个专横的住户、他那极度顺从的妻子，还有一位老朋友突如其来的拜访。更麻烦的是，沃罗妮卡的新“食谱”对身体产生了意想不到的影响，她开始不断长大，发生变化……
